editorial.blurb: This phenomenal pho destination serves extraordinarily fresh, generously portioned bowls with impeccable service and an elegant, welcoming atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive between 4-6pm on weekends to avoid the dinner rush around 7:30pm, and don't miss the chef's special oxtail pho—the meat falls off the bone and the broth strikes the perfect balance of sweetness with hints of cinnamon.
